info.title: HAL 9000 house knowledge
info.description: The contract between the knowledge-base backend and its web UI (docs/KNOWLEDGE_PLAN.md §11).

post.description: Exchange the household passcode for a signed session cookie (30 days).
Upload many files; folder paths become collections. Returns job IDs.

get.description: Live job progress (server-sent events): the recent jobs, then every change.

200.description: SSE: one `job` event (a Job) per change

post.description: Queue a failed job again with its original parameters.

409.description: Only a failed job can be retried

patch.description: Edit metadata; user edits always win over segmentation (the file is re-indexed).

post.description: Re-run ingestion for the document's file (embeddings and labels are cached).

200.description: The original. PDFs inline with range support; anything else as a sandboxed attachment.

get.description: Cleaned page (or pseudo-page) text and the chunk spans on it.

post.description: Ask a question. Read the stream with fetch + ReadableStream, not EventSource.

200.description: SSE over the POST response. Events: status, sources, token, reset, verify, done; each `data:` line is the matching ChatEventEnvelope.event.

409.description: No index profile is active yet

post.description:
Thumbs up/down, a comment, and optionally "Add to question set".

One row per message: a later post for the same message updates it.

get.description: Retrieval only, with scores (debugging and retrieval-only mode).

patch.description: Approve, edit or reject a question-set item.

put.description: Mike's rubric labels for one generated answer (gate G-K1b).

get.description: One run's per-question results, a page at a time.

put.description: Make an existing, built profile the one that serves the chat.

get.description: The Query Inspector's data for one question.

Unauthenticated (LAN only); never exposes question text.

Also writes ``data/knowledge_health.json`` for HAL's watchdog.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: A finished answer, as sent in the chat stream's ``done`` event (plan §11).

relative_path.title: Relative Path
relative_path.description: each file's path within its chosen folder, in order

ChatEventEnvelope.title: ChatEventEnvelope
ChatEventEnvelope.description: Documents the ``POST /api/chat`` stream: each SSE ``data:`` line is one ``event``.

ChatResetEvent.title: ChatResetEvent
ChatResetEvent.description: SSE ``reset``: clear the partial answer; a regeneration follows (plan §7.1 verify).

ChatSourcesEvent.title: ChatSourcesEvent
ChatSourcesEvent.description: SSE ``sources``: the numbered sources the answer may cite.

ChatStatusEvent.title: ChatStatusEvent
ChatStatusEvent.description: SSE ``status``: the pipeline stage now running.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: A ``[S#]`` source in an answer; opens the viewer at ``page``.

DocumentMeta.title: DocumentMeta
DocumentMeta.description: A logical sub-document inside a file (plan §5.1 step 6, §12 ``documents``).

DocumentPatch.title: DocumentPatch
DocumentPatch.description: Inline metadata edits; a user edit always wins over segmentation (plan §5.1).

DocumentSummary.title: DocumentSummary
DocumentSummary.description: A Library row (plan §10): a sub-document with its file and index state.

EvalMetrics.title: EvalMetrics

EvalQuestionResult.title: EvalQuestionResult
EvalQuestionResult.description:
One question's result in an eval run: ``GET /api/eval/runs/{id}/results`` items.

``recall`` is keyed by the token budget as a string (``"2000"``); a missing
key means N/A (the chunk size exceeds the budget, or the item is
unanswerable).

EvalResultsPage.title: EvalResultsPage
EvalResultsPage.description: A page of an eval run's per-question results.

EvalRun.title: EvalRun
EvalRun.description: One sweep stage's run (``eval_runs``; files under ``data/knowledge/eval/runs/<id>/``).

EvidenceQuote.title: EvidenceQuote
EvidenceQuote.description: A verbatim quote from one page of cleaned text (plan §8.1).

FeedbackRequest.title: FeedbackRequest
FeedbackRequest.description:
Feedback on one answer. One row per message: a later POST updates it.

``rating`` may be left out only to add the answer to the question set.

GoldPatch.title: GoldPatch
GoldPatch.description: A review decision or edit on the Evaluation page (plan §8.1, gate G-K1).

MetricCI.title: MetricCI
MetricCI.description: A point estimate with its bootstrap 95% interval (plan §8.2).

PageView.title: PageView
PageView.description: Cleaned page (or pseudo-page) text and the active profile's chunk spans on it.

RetrievalResult.title: RetrievalResult
RetrievalResult.description: Everything retrieval decided for one question (plan §7.1).

RetrievedChunk.title: RetrievedChunk
RetrievedChunk.description: A chunk as retrieval ranked it. Scores are ``None`` where that retriever didn't see it.

RubricLabels.title: RubricLabels
RubricLabels.description: The judge rubric (plan §8.4.1), as labelled by Mike or by the judge.

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: The closed set of stage names (plan §9.2).

StageTiming.title: StageTiming
StageTiming.description: One timed stage. ``started_ms`` is relative to the trace start.

TraceHit.title: TraceHit
TraceHit.description: A retrieved chunk as recorded in a trace: IDs, scores and ranks, no text.

TraceSummary.title: TraceSummary
TraceSummary.description:
A Traces-page row (the in-app list, behind the passcode).

Grafana reads the ``traces`` table's scalar columns, never this model, so
the question text here doesn't reach it.

UploadResult.title: UploadResult
UploadResult.description: What happened to one uploaded file (plan §5.1 steps 1–3).
